biological_question: Do Palearctic terrestrial insects inferred to share Last Glacial Maximum climatic refugial opportunity show concordant geographic locations of within-species mitochondrial genetic discontinuity?

candidate_universe.geographic_unit: exact unique latitude-longitude localities from the frozen COI genetic sampling panel
candidate_universe.interpretation: Realm eligibility describes the geography actually represented by the genetic panel, not the species' complete geographic range.

palearctic_rule.authoritative_dataset: WWF (2004) Simplified Biogeographical Realms of the World, generalized from Olson et al. (2001), UNEP-WCMC service

terrestrial_core_rule.rationale: Conservative terrestrial-core panel. Diptera and Hemiptera are excluded in v0.1 because the available species span mixed aquatic/terrestrial life histories; obligately aquatic-immature orders are excluded.

role_split.rule: Sort eligible species by SHA256('palearctic-insect-lgm-v0.1|'+species); lower half = source, upper half = target.

development_note: A crude latitude/longitude proxy was inspected during method development and suggested that a panel of roughly several dozen species may exist. That proxy has no authority. Only the WWF realm assignment above determines eligibility.
